title: India's Motor Accident Compensation Increased to ₹10 Lakh Despite Lack of Appeal
summary: The AP High Court has enhanced motor accident compensation to ₹10 lakh without an appeal from claimants, citing a legal precedent. This decision affects the lives of many Indians who rely on this compensation for their livelihoods. The ruling highlights the importance of considering functional loss in determining compensation.
summary_points: India's motor accident compensation has been increased to ₹10 lakh by the AP High Court
The increase occurred despite no appeal from claimants
The court cited a legal precedent for its decision
Functional loss is now considered key in determining compensation
This ruling affects many Indians who rely on this compensation

summary_hi: एपी उच्च न्यायालय ने दुर्घटना के बाद आर्थिक सहायता ₹10 लाख तक बढ़ाई है, जिस पर कोई अपील नहीं है। अदालत ने एक कानूनी प्रारंभिक मानक को उद्धृत किया है। इस निर्णय से कई भारतीयों की जिंदगी प्रभावित होगी। यह निर्णय महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि अब कौशल खोन को ध्यान में रखकर आर्थिक सहायता निर्धारित की जाएगी।
